changelog:
- Initial release of the ComfyUI Runner skill.
- Supports running local ComfyUI workflows via the HTTP API, using either the bundled default workflow or user-supplied files/JSON.
- Edits workflow JSON on-the-fly: updates text prompt, style, and seed based on user input when possible.
- Provides automatic handling for downloading and installing model weights from user-supplied URLs into proper ComfyUI subfolders.
- Ensures generated images are always delivered to the user after a successful run.
summary: Run and customize local ComfyUI workflows via HTTP API to generate images from prompts, run user workflows, or download model weights for use.
